jobs_results.title: Data Analyst - Global Partner Ads (They/She/He)
jobs_results.description:
Data Analyst - Global Partner Ads (They/She/He)

Not your usual app. We are the fastest-growing multi-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores.

We operate in more than 1500 cities across 25 countries. Every year, +200k merchants generate over 4B€ in sales through our platform and over 20M customers get their goods delivered in minutes.

We have a vision: To give everyone easy access to anything in their cities.

And this is where your ride starts…

YOUR MISSION

You will be a key resource to provide revenue and pricing insights and solutions to Glovo’s commercial teams dedicated to distribution of advertising and monetization products. You will use and generate information resources regarding our Partner’s KPIs, historical data, market conditions, and internal margin/revenue targets to prepare revenue forecasts & models... internal proposals regarding pricing and sales strategies for future products/campaigns/seasons/segments.

In this role you will be part of the Partners Team at Glovo HQ, being able to Improve Glovo’s food partners P&L and creating a scalable revenue stream. Working in the Global team you will play a pivotal role for the teams in all our geographies to deliver the Ads & Monetisation business plan contributing directly to the company P&L.

You’ll be part of a new area and have the opportunity to work on new solutions and bring existing ones to the next level.

Experimentation, learning and quick iterations will be part of your daily life.

THE JOURNEY
• Develop and distribute weekly, monthly and quarterly dynamic forecasts of expected revenue results, variances and budget comparisons.
• Develop and maintain the key data data funnels of the Partners ads vertical (i.e. sales , penetration, retention) setting up and support centralized dashboards.
• Deliver growth and profitability models to plan and size business initiatives and investment areas.
• Establish and measure adequate KPIs to assess local performance and determine the effectiveness of the implemented initiatives (e.g., new assets)
• Grow Advertising revenue & maximize profitability by identifying actions, that encourage higher sale values, volumes, conversion rates, margin rates, and customer satisfaction
• Lead revenue-related projects including establishing timelines, defining deliverables, and drafting communications or presentations
• Conduct trainings to ensure all impacted colleagues are fully competent in the use of all tools, processes and insights
• Ensure all related systems are configured correctly, validated and working to full capacity
• Provide guidance and support to business leaders and stakeholders on how best to harness available data in support of critical business needs and goals
• Drive clarity and solve ambiguous, challenging business problems using data-driven approaches
• Own the reporting structure for the commercial team, ensuring our team is both data driven and aligned.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE
• 2-4 years of professional experience outside of an academic and internship setting, in a quantitative analysis role, preferably in commercial facing teams
• Demonstrated proficiency in working with clean & optimized SQL and python, querying mid to large volumes of data.
• In-depth knowledge of BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, and practical experience analyzing data, program metrics, and performance
• Ability to summarize and represent data (e.g., descriptive statistics and graphs).
• Ability to create robust, insightful, and story-telling visualizations using modern BI & Analytics tools and ability to identify data Issues.
• Familiarity with a collaborative environment and/or version control (GitHub, Git).
• Ability to build hypotheses and test them (sometimes by piloting projects entirely)
• Project management / coordination skills. Determined to get things done
• Understanding of A/B test principles, to design, conduct and analyze different experiments.
• You are eager to learn, hungry for knowledge, and want to work towards growing in your career from day one.
• You are independent in solving problems within your capabilities and proactive in asking for support when the task is beyond your expertise.
• You are not afraid of giving/receiving constant & honest feedback
• Excellent spoken and written English.
• Bachelor in, economics, statistics, math or engineering preferred

PLUS TO HAVE
• Experience within the digital advertising industry and data monetisation

Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We believe driven talent deserves:
• 🌟 An enticing equity plan *if applicable
• 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
• 🍔 Monthly Glovo meal benefits so you can test new features in our beta app (and to satisfy your cravings!)
• 💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses or office-based nursery.
• 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
• 🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year. .
• 👪 Enhanced parental leave (*if applicable)
• 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

At Glovo, we truly value diversity for the positive impact it brings to our teams, products, and culture. We're dedicated to providing equal opportunities for talent from all backgrounds.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website

jobs_results.description:
Desde The Wise Seeker estamos buscando a un profesional para cubrir el puesto de Analista de Datos y Procesamiento deSeales para trabajar con uno de nuestros clientes final:una empresa fabricante ingeniera e integrador de soluciones de monitorizacin de alto rendimiento con productos propios para la monitorizacin de activos e infraestructuras mediante el empleo de fibra ptica distribuida / lineal.

Lugar:Pamplona/Irua Navarra

Sector: Otros

Funciones
• Obtener y transformar datos obtenidos mediante sensores de fibra ptica distribuidos
• Analizar y comparar datos procedentes de diferentes fuentes para aportar valor: climatolgicas y meteorolgicas
• Desarrollo de algoritmos para limpiar y mejorar la calidad de los datos obtenidos
• Participacin en equipo de trabajo de procesado de seales

Requisitos
• Mster o licenciatura en Ingenieras relacionadas con el anlisis de seales digitales (Telecomunicacin Informtica Ciencias de la computacin o Matemticas)
• Ms de 1 ao de experiencia como... Analista de Datos o similares
• Dominio de lenguaje python y en el empleo de libreras de procesamiento de seales
• Trabajo en equipo y grandes dotes comunicativas.
• Deseable: Nivel ingls (B2 o C1)
#LIGS1

jobs_results.title: Analista de datos
jobs_results.description:
Tenth Revolution somos una compañía especializada en selección de perfiles tecnológicos y digitales. Tenemos presencia en EE. UU., EMEA y APAC. Actualmente nos encontramos en búsqueda de un perfil especialista en el analisis de datos para uno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

Se trata de una empresa especialista en soluciones de software para el mapeo terrestre basado en imágenes. Se enfocan sobre todo en las industrias de: topografía, construcción, ingeniería, forestal y agricultura.

Son más de 200 personas y tiene oficinas en Europa, Asia y EEUU.

Funciones:
• Data Analysis and Insights: Conduct comprehensive analysis of marketing data including website traffic, user behavior, campaign performance, and customer demographics. Extract actionable insights and trends from data to inform marketing strategies, optimization efforts, and decision-making processes.
• Web Development and Maintenance: Design, develop, and maintain Company´s websites and digital platforms to ensure... optimal performance, user experience, and functionality. Implement front-end enhancements, UI/UX improvements, and responsive design principles to enhance user engagement and conversion rates.
• Automation and Workflow Optimization: Develop and implement automated workflows, scripts, and tools to streamline repetitive tasks, data processing, and reporting within the marketing department. Leverage automation techniques to improve efficiency, scalability, and accuracy in data collection, analysis, and campaign execution processes.
• Technical Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, IT, and data analytics to integrate marketing technology platforms, CRM systems, and analytics tools. Ensure seamless data flow, integration, and synchronization across different systems and platforms to maintain data integrity and consistency.
• Data Visualization and Reporting: Create interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio. Present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and visually appealing manner to stakeholders and decision-makers within the organization.

Requisitos:
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or SQL for data manipulation, analysis, and automation tasks. Strong understanding of web development technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and familiarity with content management systems (CMS) such as WordPress or Drupal.
• Data Analysis and Visualization: Experience with data analysis tools and techniques, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics. Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio to create meaningful and actionable visualizations.
• Marketing Acumen: Understanding of marketing principles, digital marketing channels, and campaign metrics. Ability to translate marketing objectives and requirements into technical solutions and actionable insights.
• Problem-Solving and Collaboration: Excellent problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and work towards common goals.
• Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in computer science, data analytics, marketing, or a related field. Prior experience in data analysis, web development, and automation within a marketing or digital environment is preferred.

Condiciones:
• Remoto: 3 días de teletrabjo a la semana
• Ubicación: Goya
• Salario: Competitivo (europeo)
• Beneficios: Tarjeta restaurante + Seguro Médico
• Ambiente internacional

jobs_results.title: Administrator /analista de datos estadísticos/as
jobs_results.description:
• DESCRIPTION OF THE WORK / TASKSUnder the supervision of the survey coordinator and in close coordination with team members, the main function and duties will be the assistance to the project Workers Exposure Survey : · Prepare the survey data for sharing in a data repository for researchers : - manage the different data files, in particular combine different data files (sav and csv formats), using the relevant statistical software;
• reflect on a relevant and useful format and appropriate content for sharing the dataset, in particular cleaning the dataset from information that is not useful for the purpose, and considering the final size of the dataset;
• draft a short document explaining how to use the dataset;. Analyse the data applying relevant statistical methods and techniques : - carry out statistical analyses according to the analysis plan defined by the survey coordinator and team, with the view of supporting the drafting of publications and communication outputs planned for... 2024;
• raise and discuss the advantages, drawbacks and limitations of the methods and techniques proposed;- contribute to the revision of the analysis plan with the supervisor and the team members.

We expect the temporary support to regularly present the results of the work to the supervisor (orally or in writing) and to document all the steps and programs in writing, so that they could be replicated at any moment after the temporary support has left.

If R is used, the main steps will need to be transcripted into SPSS syntax, as it is the main software used by the team members.

Suggestions on statistical analyses are encouraged and welcome on an on-going basis.En Adecco creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades y apostamos por el Talento Sin Etiquetas

Requisitos REQUIREMENTSEDUCATION : · Degree in statistics or similar / Grado en estadístico / a, estadístico / a aplicada o similar.

ESSENTIAL : · Very good statistical and data analysis skills.· Very good proficiency of SPSS and / or R (or similar statistical software or programming language).
• Experience in carrying out the tasks described above : preparing a dataset for sharing with data users, statistical data analysis following a plan and taking into account the output, explaining, arguing and discussing different options for analysis, documenting the different steps carried out.
• Detail- and quality-oriented person.· Satisfactory knowledge of English (equivalent to B2 level).· Capacity to work well in a team, and also independently.
• Good interpersonal skills, and adaptability skills (to different working methods, people and areas of work).· Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite particularly Excel and Word.

ASSETS : · Experience in health statistics, epidemiology, exposure data, occupational safety and health.· Experience of cross-country data analysis.

Experience of an international / multicultural environment.

Responsabilidades

PLACE OF WORK : · Bilbao (Agency premises are in Miribilla)· Teleworking is offeredTendrás un contrato a través de Adecco de 4 meses de duraciónTrabajarás de lunes a viernes en horario de jornada partidaGanarás un salario de 25,95 euros brutos hora

jobs_results.title: Analista datos / business intelligence
jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

• Recoger, analizar e interpretar datos.
• Colaboración con distintas áreas de la empresa (HR y Contabilidad).
• Crear cuadros de mandos y presentar resultados a la dirección.
• Gestionar y mantener bbdd
• Propuestas de mejora. Tu experiencia y punto de vista será crucial para el equipo. Cuentan con tu proactividad para proponer mejoras y para explotar la información que nos dan los datos.
• Soporte analítico en la toma de decisiones
• A nivel de competencias personales, buscamos alguien con capacidad analítica, con proactividad para proponer ideas, con buena interlocucción para presentar información al resto del equipo, con compromiso y con elevada discrección ya que se trabajará con información confidencial.
• IT STACK: trabajarás con excel, SQL, PowerBI, Azure. Gran apertura a proponer otras tecnologías según necesidad de la compañía y crecimiento que, con tu punto de vista profesional, puedas considerar enriquecedor.
• De forma puntual, habrá... desplazamientos nacionales para reuniones con el equipo.

• Contrato indefinido|Empresa final
• Formación universitaria. Necesitamos grado en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, ADE.
• Valoramos formación en Big Data.
• Experiencia previa como Data Analyst de alrededor de 3 años.
• Inglés B2-C1. De forma puntual, será necesario coordinar reuniones en inglés.
• Conocimiento y administración bbdd
• Dominio Excel, SQL, PowerBI
• Valoramos nociones de Azure, Python y Big Data.

• Se trata de una asociación sin ánimo de lucro vinculada al sector educativo.
• Ambiente no jerárquico, cercano y donde el trabajo en equipo es una de las principales características.
• Ubicación: Madrid Centro.

• Contrato indefinido
• Jornada completa
• Salario a valorar según recorrido previo. La banda estimada que tiene la compañía es 35-45K
• Modalidad presencial, zona Madrid Centro.
• Flexibilidad entrada y salida.
• Viernes jornada intensiva y varias semanas de verano también
